'''HK-57''' was a [[HK-series assassin droid]] produced in an old [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Old Research Facility|droid factory]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] under the control of rogue assassin droid [[HK-47]]. After flaws in the HK-57 and subsequent [[HK-67]] models were discovered, HK-47 initiated the creation of a new model, the [[HK-77 assassin droid|HK-77]] droid.

==Behind the scenes==
This droid model is mentioned in a message recorded by HK-47. The message is available on a datapad called "Droid Factory Records" in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' addon [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']], which players acquire during the missions leading up to the confrontation with HK-47 in the [[Battle of Koseyet]].
